BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Foundations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.

4. When learning Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

7. When learning Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing.

8. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

9. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

10. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.

11. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.

12. When learning Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Timbering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Foundation Walling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plumbing Tools and Equipment 4.2 Plumbin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
